To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a gene encoding a protein with a high homology to Vibrio parahemolyticus irgA, which functions as the outer-membrane receptor for ferric enterobactin, was identified in the A. hydrophia ATCC 79661(T) genome, and this protein was designated as IrgA.
the irgA gene encodes a TonB2-dependent outer membrane receptor for Ent and that the transcription of the irgA and TonB2 system genes is regulated in response to iron.
the A. hydrophi la ATCC 7965 (T) irgA gene is involved in ferric enterobactin uptake and that the irgA and tonB2 genes are regulated by iron.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new siderophore utilization system in A. hydrophilia ATCC 7965(T).
the identification and characterization of the Ent receptor in A. hydrophilia, a potential pathogen that causes gastroenteritis in humans.
the characterization of the irgA gene and its function in iron acquisition by A. hydrophilia ATCC 7965(T).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
A. hydrophilia ATCC 7965(T) utilizes ferric Ent for growth under iron starvation and that the TonB2-dependent outer membrane receptor IrgA is responsible for the uptake of ferric Ent.
A. hydrophilia ATCC 7967(T) uses Ent for iron uptake and that this uptake is mediated by IrgA and the Ton2B system.
IrgA is an Ent receptor and that the TonB2-dependent system functions as an energy source for IrgA in A. hydrophilia ATCC 7967(T).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
A. hydrophilia ATCC 7967(T) has a TonB-dependent outer membrane receptor (IrgA) for ferric Ent.
the A. hydrophilic TonB2 system and the IrgA protein function together to utilize Ent under iron-limiting environments.
the TonB2-IrgA system in A. hydrophilia is a novel Ent uptake system that is involved in iron acquisition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
A. hydrophilia ATCC 7967(T) can utilize Ent as an iron source and that IrgA is the receptor for Ent.
